claim_text: RoPE rotates each absolute position, and the attention score depends only on the relative distance between the tokens.

spec.explain: Toy dial illustration for arXiv 2104.09864: two rotating RoPE hands whose angle gap sets attention. Watch the score number: it depends only on relative distance, going to zero at the flip.

questions.q: Set m to 10: what happens to the score? Do you expect shifting m and n together to change it?
questions.why: misconception about absolute versus relative position

questions.q: Set m to 5: what happens to the score?
Set n to 12: what happens to rel_dist?
Set th to 1.2: what happens to the score?
